root_cause: The single CI workflow ran full Linux checks and macOS resource integration for stabilization tracking-only commits. Ref-scoped ci-main concurrency serialized a newer runtime push behind that work, delaying current development artifact evidence.

source_provenance.observation: Tracking job was still in full CI while the newer runtime job queued; later runtime job terminal state was cancelled. No jobs were dispatched or cancelled by this change.

change: A fetched exact comparison range is classified against the existing development artifact runtime-equivalent stabilization path list. Commit history is inspected as well as endpoint diff, so an intermediate runtime edit cannot disappear through a revert. Only proven stabilization records enter the docs validation job. Unknown, missing, unrelated, tag, runtime, configuration, workflow, lockfile, and toolchain changes enter full CI. Docs validation checks diff whitespace, JSON and JSONL syntax, full tracked-file lint, inventory truth, and workflow cost. Full CI still owns native integration and development artifact production; docs CI creates no artifact.

green: 13 focused fixture tests passed, including docs-only, runtime, lockfile, workflow, unknown, missing base, reverted runtime history, malformed JSON/JSONL, and workflow artifact wiring
